generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.

Tenderer shall obtain the Work Done Certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer( District Level Officer), scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the tender. The Original Certificate shall be produced at the time of opening of Technical Bids for physical verification

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards labour welfare fund.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.

All necessary arrangements shall be made and precaution taken to prevent completely or partially, damage to the structure or labours / employees during construction period. (As per recent Labour Act) Contractor shall be fully responsible for any damage to the structure during the construction and maintainance period.Any damage caused due to any reasons shall be rectified / replaced at his own cost as per the direction of Engineer in charge. Nothing shall be payable by the Department on account of inclusive of all such arrangements/ precautions work needed.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject one or all Tenders without assigning any reasons.
The Item Rates quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on constructive materials
The awarded Contractor has to Submit his bills through e-MB for payment.( Billing is through e-Mb ie: Contractor has to produce Soft copy and hard Copy of RA or Final bill for payments)
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delays as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.
The item rates are excluding GST but inclusive of all other charges.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.
AS per GO FD 876 Exp-12/2017, Blore dated 10/10/2017 The Clause 9.1 (EMD) ,3.1(Bid Capacity) ,24.1(FSD) of KW 1 are modified
EMD of Rs.6800.00 should be paid in Single Payment
Tender period for work completion 12 Calendar Months (including monsoon period)

Contractors registered under class-1 and 2 may tender for works anywhere in the state.Contactors registered under class-3 may tender for works within the districts of the PWD circles where in they are registered. Contactors registered under-4 may tender for works within the districts or within the division whichever is applicable

Estimate rates are excluding GST and the prevailing GST 18 percent of APT is added in the form of Lumpsum in santioned estimate as per the guidelines in common SR 2021-22 GO PWD51 RDF 2019 Bengaluru dt 18-03-2022. Therefore ,APT or ECV is excluding GST . In kppp portal there is no option to add GST separately over and above APT during DTS process. Hence even through the tender has been invited by opting for the INCLUSIVE option , the item wise rates do not include GST . Hence GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount as per the Govt. circular no FD/447/expenditure/12/2022/dt -30-07-2022. Therefore GST declaration certificate must be uploaded mandatorily by the prospective bidders.
Uploading documents duly attested by Gazzeted Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer/ Notary and also produce original documents for confirmation at the time of opening.
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP portal
The contractor must provide barricades, precautionary boards and safety measures at the work site
Tenderer should maintain the road free from pothole from the commencement of work, other wise action will be taken for termination of tender.

All necessary arrangements shall be made and precaution taken to prevent completely or partially, damage to the structure or labours / employees during construction period. (As per recent Labour Act) Contractor shall be fully responsible for any damage to the structure during the construction and maintainance period.Any damage caused due to any reasons shall be rectified / replaced at his own cost as per the direction of Engineer in charge. Nothing shall be payable by the Department on account of inclusive of all such arrangements/ precautions work needed

Tenderer shall obtain the Work Done Certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer( District Level Officer), scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the tender. The Original Certificate shall be produced at the time of opening of Technical Bids for physical verification
Road maintenance period is one year from the date of work order issued.

The construction materials (minerals metal ,sand and Murom) shall be bought from the authorized quarries along with the mineral dispatch permit or else 5 times the royalty will be deducted as penalty as per the Directions on the Director, Mines and Geology Department Bangalore proceedings dated 25.03.2013.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/95/LET/2013 Bangalore dated 01.04.2013 the Contractor shall be registered under section 7 of Buildings and other Construction workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act and the construction labour shall get the registration under section 12 of the act before making payment of running bills
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-1 KPWD and further orders thereon
The Contractor belonging to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribe shall be domicile certificate of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years Compulsory
Reserved SC Category Certificate

As per the Secial Gazzette Finance Secretriat Notification No 876 Exp-12/2017 Bengaluru Dated 15.09.2017 & Govt order No-FD-506 EXP-12/2024 Bngalore DT:20.08.2024 the following conditions shall apply for the works reserved for Scheduled caste and Scheduled Tribes & Category-1 and Category 2A) If no Qualified Tenderers belonging to Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes Participate in the bid in two attempts under this rule, then these two works shall be tendered as open catergory wherein all eligible bidders of General or Scheduled castes and Scheduled Tribes category can participate.

itemList.description: Clearing    and    grubbing    road    land    including    uprooting    rank vegetation,  grass,  bushes,  shrubs,  saplings  and  trees  girth  up  to 300  mm,  removal  of  stumps  of  trees  cut  earlier  and  disposal  of unserviceable  materials  and  stacking  of  serviceable  material  to be used or auctioned,  including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer - In area of light jungle ---- as per the direction of Engineer incharge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1908 ---- as per the direction of Engineer incharge of the work.

Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- as per the direction of Engineer incharge of the work.

Restoration of rain cuts with soil, moorum, gravel or a mixture of these, clearing the loose soil, benching for 300 mm width, laying  fresh  material  in  layers  not  exceeding  250  mm  and compacting with plate compactor or power rammers to restore the original alignment, levels and slopes. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3002 ---- as per the direction of Engineer incharge of the work.

Maintenance of Earthen Shoulder (filling with fresh soil) - Making  up  loss  of  material/  irregularities  on  shoulder  to  the design level by adding fresh approved soil and compacting it with appropriate equipment.Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- as per the direction of Engineer incharge of the work.

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- as per the direction of Engineer incharge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Painting two coats with synthetic enamel paint. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913 ---- as per the direction of Engineer incharge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Printing  letters  and  figures  of  any  shade  with  synthtic enamel  paint  of  any  approved  colour  to  give  an  even shade. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913 ---- as per the direction of Engineer incharge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: White  washing  of  parapet  walls  of  CD  work  and  tree trunks - White washing two coats on parapet walls and tree trunks including preparation of surface by cleaning scraping etc. as per technical specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1916 ---- as per the direction of Engineer incharge of the work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Culverts - Maintenance  of  Hume  pipe  Culvert  by  way  of    Clearing, Cleaning, Erosion repair, repairs to cracks, parapet wall and protection work as per drawing and technical specification Clause 1909. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1909 ---- as per the direction of Engineer incharge of the work.

Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base course using material confirming to WBM Grade -II with B type Screenings standards wherever necessary by manual means including trimming the pothole to the required shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- as per the direction of Engineer incharge of the work.
